LESSON: LISTENING FOR GIST

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Listening and speaking
Topic 1.3: Listening for gist
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 3

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Listening for gist, part of Listening and speaking in Grade 5 GERMAN.

Key inquiry question: How do we ensure we get necessary information from a listening text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to a list of items in the classroom and repeat,

2. listen to texts on items in the classroom and match to given pictures,

3. listen to a list of names of colours and repeat,

4. watch video describing colour of things found in the classroom (z.B Der Kuli ist blau) and match to given flashcards,

5. play a game with peers asking about items in the classroom (z.B Was ist das? - Der Kuli natürlich),

6. listen to names of different learning areas and the classroom items associated with them (z.B Das ist mein Deutschbuch, .../Ich lerne Mathe, ... )

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to a list of items in the classroom and repeat,
2. listen to texts on items in the classroom and match to given pictures,
3. listen to a list of names of colours and repeat,
4. watch video describing colour of things found in the classroom (z.B Der Kuli ist blau) and match to given flashcards,
5. play a game with peers asking about items in the classroom (z.B Was ist das? - Der Kuli natürlich),
6. listen to names of different learning areas and the classroom items associated with them (z.B Das ist mein Deutschbuch, .../Ich lerne Mathe, ... )

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Listening for gist together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Creativity and Imagination: The learner enhances their creativity as they play a game with peers asking about the items in the

classroom (z.B Was ist das? - Der Kuli natürlich.)

Values:
Unity: The learner works collaboratively as they as they play a game with peers asking about the items in the classroom (z.B

Was ist das? - Der Kuli natürlich.).
